# Jason Operations Overview

Grafana provides Jason's operational presentation layer. Jason remains authoritative for identity, policy, approvals, capability resolution, execution, configuration, secrets, and audit.

**Current phase:** read-only foundation. No provider writes are exposed from this dashboard.

### Planned live source
`GET /api/management/v0.1/system/health`

Kernel, orchestrator, and subsystem health.

### Planned live source
`GET /api/management/v0.1/capabilities`

Registered capabilities, versions, modes, risk, and approval requirements.

### Planned live source
`GET /api/management/v0.1/providers`

Provider readiness and health without credential exposure.

### Planned live source
`GET /api/management/v0.1/approvals`

Pending human actions visible to the authenticated principal.

### Planned live source
`GET /api/management/v0.1/audit/events`

Executions, policy outcomes, principals, correlation IDs, and evidence references.

### Planned live source
`GET /api/management/v0.1/configuration`

Read-only governed configuration inventory. Future changes must use governed capabilities.

### Secret metadata
`GET /api/management/v0.1/secrets`

Never display raw secret values.

### Platform Stewardship
Dependency health, API changes, deprecations, and retirement candidates will be added as governed sources mature.
